problems.title: Two quadratic equations
problems.question: Solve (a) x²-7x+10=0; (b) 10x²-29x+10=0.
problems.idea: Factor the first and use the discriminant for the second.

problems.title: A cube factor hidden inside squared factors
problems.question: Simplify (1+2/√a+4/a)²(1-2/√a)² divided by ((a√a-8)/199)²; evaluate at a=√199.
steps: Division by (t³-8)²/199² leaves 199²/a³. The original domain is a>0,a≠4.

problems.title: A number equals the result of a quadratic procedure
problems.question: A number is multiplied by three times itself, then 2 is subtracted and the result divided by 4 to recover the original number. Find it.
steps: Both real values satisfy the procedure.

problems.title: Rationalize a sum of three radicals
problems.question: Rationalize the denominator of 1/(√3+√5+√10).

problems.title: Minimum of a positive reciprocal-plus-linear sum
problems.question: For x>0, minimize 19/(2x)+5x/3 and state the input giving equality.
formulas: u+v≥2√(uv), with equality u=v for u,v>0.
steps: The product of the two terms is 95/6.

problems.title: Tangency requires one intersection
problems.question: Find k for which y=kx+3k-1 is tangent to y=x².
problems.idea: Their intersection equation must have a repeated root.

problems.title: Projection differences and a leg ratio
problems.question: A right triangle has leg ratio 4:7 and hypotenuse-projection difference 33. Find the hypotenuse.
problems.idea: Write the legs 4t,7t and hypotenuse c.
steps: The difference condition gives 33t²/c=33, so t²=c.
Substitute into c²=65t² to obtain c²=65c.

problems.title: Circle contacts inside a 60-degree angle
problems.question: Two circles of radii 3,10 are inscribed in the same 60° angle and touch one side at A,B. Find AB.
problems.idea: Measure each contact from the angle vertex.

problems.title: Incenter and circumcenter in coordinates
problems.question: A right triangle has legs 10,24. Find the distance between its incenter and circumcenter.
problems.idea: Put the right vertex at the origin and legs on the axes.
steps: The hypotenuse midpoint, hence circumcenter, is O=(5,12).

problems.title: A midline makes a small isosceles triangle
problems.question: K∈AC with AK:KC=1:2, M is midpoint of BC and AC=3AB. Prove MKB=90°.
problems.idea: Let N be the midpoint of AC.
steps: Triangle ABK is isosceles, so AKB=(180°-A)/2 and BKN=90°+A/2.
Triangle KMN is isosceles with NK=NM. Its angle KNM=180°-A, so MKN=A/2.
The angle between KB and KM is therefore BKN-MKN=90°.
